queries.query: Which three matching mechanisms can cause SuggestionsFor to suggest an available child command?

judgements.reason: It uses EqualFold when enabled and exact string equality otherwise.

queries.query: Under what condition does forceMultiLine append a newline to a string?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: It appends a newline only to strings longer than 60 characters that contain no newline already.

queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: Only a root with subcommands rejects an unmatched positional token; subcommands and roots without subcommands accept arbitrary arguments.

queries.query: In command.go, where is a global flag-normalization function applied and how does it reach existing children?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: It is installed on local and persistent flag sets, stored on the command, and recursively applied to current children.

queries.query: In command.go, how does getOut choose a writer when the current command has no output writer?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: It uses the current writer when present, otherwise recursively inherits from the parent, finally falling back to the provided default.

queries.query: In completions.go, which long and shorthand flag-name candidates are emitted, and why is the equals form omitted?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: Matching long and shorthand names are emitted with usage descriptions; equals variants are deliberately not suggested to avoid forcing extra typing and lengthening lists.

queries.query: In flag_groups.go, when does validation of a required-together group succeed and what does its error identify?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: The group succeeds when none or all are set; a partial selection returns a deterministic error naming the missing flags.

queries.query: In shell_completions.go, what annotation does MarkFlagCustom install and what portability warning accompanies it?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: It delegates installation of a BashCompCustom handler; the API is Bash-only and Go callback registration is recommended for cross-shell use.

queries.query: In doc/md_docs.go, how are output filenames formed while recursively generating a Markdown command tree?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: Available non-help children are generated recursively, then the command path has spaces replaced by underscores and receives the .md extension under the target directory.

queries.query: In doc/man_docs.go, how does fillHeader derive missing title, section, date, and source values?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: It uppercases and escapes the name for title, defaults section to 1, uses SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH or current time, and supplies the autogenerated source unless disabled.

queries.query: In doc/rest_docs.go, how does indentString handle blank lines while adding a prefix?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: It inserts the prefix only at the beginning of non-empty lines, tracks line starts after newlines, and leaves blank lines unprefixed.

queries.query: In doc/yaml_docs.go, when does genFlagResult include a shorthand in the serialized option?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: A nonempty shorthand is included unless it has a nonempty deprecation marker; otherwise the option is emitted without shorthand.

queries.query: In command_win.go, what happens when a CLI is launched from Explorer with mousetrap help enabled?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: It prints help, sleeps for the configured positive duration or waits for Return, then exits with status 1.

queries.query: What happens at execution time when one or more flags marked as required were not supplied?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: All unchanged required-annotated flags are collected and returned in one error; validation is bypassed when flag parsing is disabled.

queries.query: If a user supplies only some flags from a required-together group, how is the invocation handled?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.anchor: they must all be set; missing %v
judgements.reason: A partial group fails and reports missing members; setting none or every member succeeds.

queries.query: How is an invocation validated when a flag group requires at least one member but none was set?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.anchor: at least one of the flags in the group [%v] is required
judgements.reason: The group fails with an error naming the group when its set count is zero, and succeeds once any member is set.

queries.query: What result is returned if a user sets two flags belonging to the same mutually exclusive group?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.anchor: none of the others can be; %v were all set
judgements.reason: More than one set member produces an error naming the group and selected members; zero or one member succeeds.

queries.query: Can a child command inherit its normal output destination from an ancestor, and what is the final fallback?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: Yes; output lookup walks parents until it finds a writer and otherwise returns the caller-supplied default.

queries.query: While locating a subcommand, how are flag values skipped and what effect does a double dash have?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: Space-separated values of non-boolean long or single short flags are skipped, and double dash terminates flag stripping.

queries.query: When command-prefix matching is enabled, under what condition is a typed prefix accepted?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: Exact name or alias matches win immediately; a prefix is accepted only when it uniquely matches one child name or alias.

queries.query: When is the default version flag added, and how is a preexisting short -v handled?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: No flag is added without a version or when version already exists; otherwise Cobra uses -v only if that shorthand is free and marks the generated flag.

queries.query: Which commands are excluded from the set of available non-help commands?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: Deprecated, hidden, and the configured help command are unavailable; remaining commands need to be runnable or contain an available descendant.

queries.query: Under which conditions does Cobra refrain from adding its default completion command?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: It refrains when disabled, when there are no subcommands, or when a child name or alias already supplies completion.

queries.query: When parsing emits a warning such as a deprecated-flag message, when is that warning printed?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: New warning text is printed only when parsing succeeded; parsing is a no-op when flag parsing is disabled.

queries.query: Trace the high-level ExecuteC flow from a possibly non-root receiver through command selection, context propagation, execution, and error/help handling.
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: Execution is redirected to root, defaults are initialized, Traverse or Find selects a command, call identity/context are propagated, execute runs, and help/errors/usage are handled under silence settings.

queries.query: What is the command execution lifecycle order after argument validation, including persistent and local hooks and flag-group checks?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: Initializers run, arguments validate, persistent pre-hooks and local pre-hook run, required/group flags validate, RunE or Run executes, then local and persistent post-hooks and finalizers run with early error returns.

queries.query: How does a Help call resolve an inherited or default help function, prepare flags, choose its stream, and handle template errors?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: A local function wins, otherwise resolution climbs parents; the default merges persistent flags, renders to stdout, reports render errors, and Help invokes it.

queries.query: How does the hidden completion request command transform and emit completion results before removing itself when unused?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: It obtains completions, filters disabled Active Help, strips descriptions/newlines and whitespace, prints results then the directive, logs to stderr, and removes the special command unless invoked.

queries.query: How does completion resolve the target command, prepare flag parsing, and recognize annotated file or directory value completion?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: It separates the unfinished token, traverses or finds the target, adds default flags, identifies flag-value completion before parsing, suppresses help/version completion, and returns extension or directory directives from annotations.

queries.query: How are a command's persistent flags and all ancestor persistent flags assembled into the effective flag set?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: The parent cache is initialized and normalized, root imports the process command-line set, every ancestor persistent set is visited into the cache, and local plus cached sets merge into Flags.

queries.query: What state changes occur when child commands are added, including parent linkage, layout metadata, normalization, and sorting state?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: Self-parenting panics; each child gains its parent, maximum display lengths update, any global normalization propagates, the child is appended, and sorting is marked stale.

queries.query: How does flag-group validation build group state and sequence the three group-rule validators?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: It skips when parsing is disabled, visits flags into separate required-together, one-required, and exclusive state maps, then validates them in that order and returns the first error.

queries.query: How are flag-group rules translated into completion-time required and hidden flags?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: A selected required-together member marks peers required; an untouched one-required group marks all required; a selected exclusive member hides every other member while keeping itself visible.

queries.query: How is one command converted into Markdown, from initialization through sections, links, autogenerated tag, and final write?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: Defaults are initialized, descriptive and runnable/example/flag sections are buffered, eligible parent and child links are sorted and emitted, the optional generation tag is added, then the buffer is written.

queries.query: How does YAML documentation generation assemble command metadata, flags, and see-also entries before serialization?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: It initializes defaults, fills identity and text, conditionally adds usage/example/local and inherited options, builds sorted eligible relations, marshals YAML, and writes it.

queries.query: Which shells support Active Help, and what Bash version constraint applies?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: The documentation names Bash V2 and Zsh, with Bash 4.4+ needed for the prompt when Active Help prints.

queries.query: How is the program-specific Active Help environment variable named and consumed by application completion code?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

queries.query: What are the documented effects of setting a program's Active Help variable to 0 versus setting COBRA_ACTIVE_HELP to 0?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: The program value disables that program's output automatically; the global value disables all Cobra programs and forces config lookup to return 0.

queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.anchor: Cobra's default `completion` command uses bash completion V2
judgements.reason: V2 omits legacy Bash dynamic completion, uses Go callbacks, supports descriptions and a smaller aligned script, and is the default command's implementation.

queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

queries.query: Which PowerShell completion modes are supported, when are descriptions displayed, and what minimum PowerShell version is required?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: TabCompleteNext, Complete, and MenuComplete are supported; descriptions show only in Complete/MenuComplete, and version 5.0+ is required.

queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: Print uses the ordinary configured output with stderr fallback, while PrintErr uses the separately configured error output with stderr fallback; line and format variants delegate accordingly.

queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: Sorting happens only when globally enabled and the cached order is stale; otherwise the current slice is returned unchanged.

queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

queries.query: What state is cleared and recreated when flags are reset on a command?
queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: The error buffer and local/persistent base flag sets are recreated, while local, inherited, and parent-persistent caches are cleared.

queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: The descendant recursively inherits the ancestor's custom function; the default is created only when no command in the chain defines one.

queries.provenance: fresh independent curator-authored from pinned Cobra source; 2026-09-13

judgements.reason: It must be non-runnable, visible, non-deprecated, and every descendant must itself qualify as an additional help topic.

judgements.reason: No; the code resets the trimmed arguments and clears the flag so processing falls back to noun completion.

judgements.reason: The parent flag is excluded from InheritedFlags when a local flag of the same name exists, so the local shadow wins outside that inherited-only view.
